answer.summary: The frontend-quality job failed on the i18n checker, not on a test. The French locale has the key "minutes" with the same value as English, so the check fails deterministically and a re-run will fail the same way. The likely cause is a new untranslated string from this change. Fix: translate it with "yarn auto-translation:all", or add it to scripts/i18n-loanwords.json if it is a legitimate loanword.
